# Status & priorities

[Wiki home](README.md) | [Edit source](../../AGENTS.md)

## Status (2026-10-13)

Journey structure (#46) playable and tested: lobby -> M33 ... LMC (5 galaxies x 4-6 systems, galaxy map warps, Warden enclaves) -> flight home with the Rift chase (#81) -> homecoming result, or crew wipe / caught by the Rift -> collapse -> loop logbook -> New Loop (deja-vu start) (#86); suspend save + continue; 2-player MP (Editor <-> dev build) warps tested. Steam is untested with 2 real accounts. Release + dev macOS builds exist in `Builds/` (git-ignored). Game feel pass #43 (hit feedback, damage taken, loot juice, dynamic music) done. Docs switched to the new gameplan (#72). Home ship Nostos (#49, 2026-10-17): docking, cryo respawn, warp lead, heavy landing; tested solo + 2-player MP, not hand-flown.

Art (2026-10-17): the look is mixed - PBR/scan assets from #91-#100 (Dart, cockpit, Mule, Nostos, crew suit, tools, enemies + Warden, station, wrecks, POIs, crates, pickups, planet terrain photo layers, planet decor, landmarks, asteroids) next to procedural parts (vents, ember rocks, arches, monoliths, bones, obsidian spires). The target is the low-poly style #120; the conversion runs in #122-#127/#133. Other known limitations: procedural placeholder audio, no terrain deformation, LOD without geomorphing, no swimming (pawns walk on the seabed), owner authority without prediction, Ark can only be claimed (not built).

## Next priorities

**The order of work is roadmap #53 (pinned, the only `documentation` issue)**: it holds nothing but the numbered issue order; work the issues strictly in that order (each one only builds on earlier ones) and take the first unchecked issue there. It is the only source of truth for the order: tick an issue there when it is merged, and don't keep a second copy of the order here. Design lives in `Assets/Design/DESIGN.md` (#72 is closed). A playtest (solo + MP) follows each phase. New ideas = new issue, slotted into #53 with a number.
Older feedback still applies: menu, graphics and gameplay need major improvement; clarify concrete goals/references with the user before large changes. Focus is gameplay; story and the low-poly conversion #120 come last in #53 (visuals may still change meanwhile). New things are built in the low-poly style right away, existing assets are only converted when a task changes them (see "Art & assets").
